changelog: **Shared hiring & company routes on the permission layer (#1571, story #1565):** the offer, company, candidate, requisition, interview-panel, interview-request, mentor-application, sales-lead, source, mentor, mentor-directory, portal job-board and onboarding routes no longer compare the caller's role to `'ADMIN'`. Pure admin gates use `requirePermission()` (`company.read`/`company.write`, `user.read`/`user.write`, `org.settings.read`/`org.settings.write` for the mentor screening policy, `audit.export` for the company export); routes that also serve mentors, mentees or companies use `requireRoleOrPermission()` and read `admin` from it; and "admins see the whole org" branches inside an already-guarded handler ask `can()` once per request. The private `requireAdmin()` of `/api/mentor-applications/[id]` is gone. The outreach list's decider-queue choice is recorded in the baseline's `allowed` (data shape, not access). Every existing ADMIN is an ORG_ADMIN and keeps everything; a signed-in caller of a role a route never admitted now gets 403 instead of 401.
